title: Dressed Floquet scars from protected zero modes in a Rydberg chain
summary: We show that a symmetry-protected Floquet nullspace can host anomalous many-body eigenstates that are obtained by projecting structured parent states onto an exact zero-quasienergy sector. We demonstrate this in a periodically driven PXP chain with an exponentially large (in system size) protected nullspace. Over the accessible system sizes, special parent states show an exponentially increasing enhancement of their nullspace weight relative to the typical value, even as their absolute overlaps decrease. The resulting Floquet scars can therefore become globally orthogonal to their parents…
